evidence: City and County of San Francisco, CA: one government; the Census carries both a county row and a place row for it.
City and County of Denver, CO.
Philadelphia, PA: city and county consolidated since 1854.
District of Columbia: the county-equivalent row is the same government as Washington city.
Carson City, NV: an independent city the county table lists as a county-equivalent.
The Bronx is a borough of the City of New York; no separate county government.
Kings County = Brooklyn, a borough of the City of New York.
New York County = Manhattan, a borough of the City of New York.
Queens County, a borough of the City of New York.
Richmond County = Staten Island, a borough of the City of New York.
Davidson County = Metropolitan Government of Nashville and Davidson County.
Jefferson County KY = Louisville/Jefferson County Metro Government (a few small cities inside opted out; the county government is Metro).
Marion County IN = Indianapolis (Unigov); the county government is the consolidated one.
Duval County = Consolidated City of Jacksonville.
Anchorage Municipality is the Municipality of Anchorage.
Juneau City and Borough (county row) = City and Borough of Juneau.
Sitka City and Borough (county row) = City and Borough of Sitka.
Wrangell City and Borough (county row) = City and Borough of Wrangell.
Orleans Parish = City of New Orleans.
East Baton Rouge Parish government is the City of Baton Rouge/Parish of East Baton Rouge (City-Parish).
Lafayette Parish government is Lafayette Consolidated Government.
Muscogee County = Columbus Consolidated Government, GA.
Clarke County = Athens-Clarke County Unified Government.
Richmond County GA = Augusta-Richmond County Consolidated Government.
Bibb County = Macon-Bibb County.
Chattahoochee County = Cusseta-Chattahoochee County Unified Government.
Quitman County = Georgetown-Quitman County Unified Government.
Echols County consolidated government (the place row is the government).
Webster County GA unified government (the place row is the government).
Fayette County KY = Lexington-Fayette Urban County Government.
Silver Bow County = Butte-Silver Bow.
Deer Lodge County = Anaconda-Deer Lodge County.
Wyandotte County = Unified Government of Wyandotte County and Kansas City, KS.
Moore County TN = Metropolitan Government of Lynchburg-Moore County.
